description: Source file for CKEditor 5's source editing feature, including plugin class definition and related functions.

classes.name: SourceEditing
classes.description: CKEditor 5 plugin class for source editing mode, managing UI and data synchronization.

methods.name: updateEditorData
methods.description: Synchronizes the editor's source data with the UI.

methods.name: _checkCompatibility
methods.description: Checks for plugin compatibility with source editing mode.

methods.name: _showSourceEditing
methods.description: Activates source editing mode, replacing content with a textarea.

methods.name: _hideSourceEditing
methods.description: Deactivates source editing mode, restoring the original content.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates UI buttons for source editing controls.
